message.text:
Checking whether memopayload.Runner is constructed at runtime.

Only one concrete implementation exists: the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, returned by `NewService`. `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` receives the interface as a parameter from `memo_service`. `server/server.go` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` to `RSSService`. `MarkdownRenderer` is used internally by `service` methods and is not a separate Service implementation.

package server

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/pkg/errors"

	"github.com/usememos/memos/internal/profile"
	storepb "github.com/usememos/memos/proto/gen/store"
	apiv1 "github.com/usememos/memos/server/router/api/v1"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/router/fileserver"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/router/frontend"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/router/mcp"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/router/rss"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/runner/s3presign"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/store"
)

const shutdownTimeout = 10 * time.Second

type Server struct {
	Secret  string
	Profile *profile.Profile
	Store   *store.Store

	echoServer *echo.Echo
	httpServer *http.Server
	sseHub     *apiv1.SSEHub

	backgroundRunnerCancels []context.CancelFunc
	backgroundRunnerWG      sync.WaitGroup
}

func NewServer(ctx context.Context, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) (*Server, error) {
	s := &Server{
		Store:   store,
		Profile: profile,
	}

	echoServer := echo.New()
	echoServer.Use(middleware.Recover())
	echoServer.Use(newCORSMiddleware(profile))
	s.echoServer = echoServer

	instanceBasicSetting, err := s.getOrUpsertInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
	}

	secret := "usememos"
	if !profile.Demo {
		secret = instanceBasicSetting.SecretKey
	}
	s.Secret = secret

	// Register healthz endpoint.
	echoServer.GET("/healthz", func(c *echo.Context) error {
		return c.String(http.StatusOK, "Service ready.")
	})

memopayload.NewRunner is never called. RebuildMemoPayload receives markdown.Service directly from APIV1Service.

The single concrete implementation is the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. `markdown.NewService` constructs it inside `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, and test helpers reuse the same constructor. `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` in `v1.go` holds the interface. `RSSService.MarkdownService` in `rss.go` also holds it, receiving the same instance from `server.go` line 85. `memopayload.Runner` holds the interface but is never instantiated in production.

`markdown.NewService` is invoked with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()`. `MarkdownRenderer` is used internally but does not implement the `markdown.Service` interface.

message.text:
The only concrete implementation is an unexported `service` struct.

Production construction traces through server.NewServer → apiv1.NewAPIV1Service → markdown.NewService. The same instance is shared by APIV1Service and RSSService. memopayload.Runner holds the interface field but never constructs it; RebuildMemoPayload receives it as a function argument from APIV1Service. MarkdownRenderer is auxiliary and not a Service implementation.
